title: Maryland homeowner gets $234,368 check for home; new law bans such offers
description: Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. Consumer advocates highlighted the risk of vulnerable owners being tricked into agreements upon receiving such checks. Historical precedents in consumer lending underline the necessity for legal protections, advising homeowners against accepting random financial items received through mail.

title: How Freddie Freeman's family shaped the Dodgers star's MLB journey
description: Freddie Freeman’s family has been with him on his baseball journey. His childhood was marked by the loss of his mother, Rosemary and father, Fred, who helped develop his swing. Years later, Freddie and Chelsea Freeman faced a serious health crisis when their son Maximus developed Guillain-Barré syndrome. His return preceded Freeman’s historic 2024 World Series performance and $1 million donation to CHOC.

title: SIR under review: Former SC, HC judges to examine 'validity' of voter roll revision
description: A panel of five former judges is being formed to review the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision. The Lawyers Association for Constitution emphasizes the panel's independence in assessing the review's validity and impact. Senior lawyers are expected to provide strategic legal advice to the panel throughout the process. The Election Commission has also initiated a drive to identify and re-enrol excluded eligible voters.

title: AI and the monk: Anthropic goes for swami and friends to tame Claude
description: Anthropic engaged various religious scholars and philosophers to explore ethical frameworks for advanced AI development. The discussions included considerations about potential moral status and consciousness in AI like Claude. Participants included Swami Sarvapriyananda, who has addressed the distinctions between intelligence and consciousness. The aim is to incorporate values from multiple faith traditions into AI training processes.

title: Father got 3 bigha in 1972; HC protects married daughter's land claim
description: In 1972, the Himachal Pradesh government allotted three bigha and two biswas of agricultural land in Shimla to a person under the Nautor rules for cultivation.  His wife died in 2012, leaving behind their only daughter, who subsequently approached the revenue authorities once again for issuance of the patta. Her request was reportedly rejected outright on the ground that married daughters were ineligible for land under the Nautor rules.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30m to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
description: In October 2024, MacKenzie Scott made headlines by donating $30 million to Housing Trust Silicon Valley via her Yield Giving fund. This substantial contribution will support various housing initiatives over the next decade, particularly focusing on enhancing homeownership assistance. Housing Trust has a successful track record, having already developed thousands of affordable homes in the Bay Area.

title: Rahul demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation as protests erupt in Delhi, Mumbai
description: Rahul Gandhi has called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation during ongoing protests. These protests arose over allegations of irregularities in the electoral-roll revision exercise. Approximately 700 protesters were detained in Delhi while trying to gather near Jantar Mantar for the demonstrations. Additional protests took place in Mumbai, where various groups demanded Kumar's resignation and accountability.

The investigation is led by UAE authorities to determine the motives and background of the co-pilot. The attack occurred during flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv, resulting in an emergency landing. The Indian captain was stabbed but managed to regain control and land safely.

His resignation follows a prolonged period of infighting over leadership roles within the party. Both Charanjit Singh Channi and Warring have seen shifts in their status amid ongoing power struggles.  But has Congress really solved the Punjab crisis?

title: Six gold medals across boxing, wrestling, hockey highlight Asian Games Day 13
description: India produced a stunning six-gold haul on the penultimate day of the Asian Games on Friday, with the women's hockey team, three boxers, archers and wrestler Sujeet Kalkal leading a late surge that took the country into the top five of the medal table. India moved to fifth place with 76 medals - 16 gold, 25 silver and 35 bronze. India have more medals than fourth-placed Uzbekistan, who have 65, but trail them by four gold medals.

title: ‘Workers growing increasingly anxious’: US adds 29k jobs, far below 90k expected
description: US employers added only 29,000 jobs in September, significantly lower than economists' expectations of 90,000. The unemployment rate rose to 4.2% as more people entered the workforce without immediate jobs. Healthcare hiring showed a notable slowdown, with government job cuts further contributing to weak hiring figures. While layoffs decreased by 18%, hiring plans fell sharply, reaching their lowest since 2011.

title: From papads to pitches: NCERT brings startup lessons to Class IX
description: A new chapter on startups and entrepreneurship has been introduced for Class IX students in NCERT textbooks. The chapter emphasizes the growth of India's startup ecosystem over the past decade. It includes important lessons on identifying business opportunities and creating effective business plans. Entrepreneurial stories, including those of Lijjat Papad and Mohan Singh Oberoi, illustrate key concepts.

From software engineer to $100-an-hour mehndi artist: How a woman turned childhood art into a side hustle
description: Priyancka Jaiin reveals how her childhood love for mehndi has blossomed into a lucrative side hustle. While maintaining her career as a software engineer, she serves clients with mehndi designs for a variety of events. Her artistry not only brings joy to brides but also supports cancer patients and mothers-to-be. Emphasizing careful practice, Jaiin showcases that a simple hobby can evolve into a significant source of creativity and fulfillment.

title: Mohsin Naqvi to skip India-Pak Asian Games gold medal match due to 'prior commitments'
description: The ACC confirmed that Naqvi will miss the final at Korogi Park because of "prior commitments". India and Pakistan will meet for the gold medal after Sri Lanka and Bangladesh play the bronze-medal match.

title: Kohli will fall short of Sachin's 100-century record: Ex-cricketer's bold prediction
description: Tendulkar played 664 international matches across formats between 1989 and 2013. He scored 100 centuries, including 51 in 200 Tests and 49 in 463 ODIs.

title: Meet Madurai’s ‘pen doctor’ keeping a 55-year-old trade alive
description: In Madurai, an elderly craftsman continues to run his pen repair shop, even as the number of customers dwindles. Positioned near the East Gate of the iconic Meenakshi Amman Temple, he dedicates his days to this trade. While digital tools dominate the market, schoolchildren still seek pens for their studies. His unwavering commitment to his craft reflects the resilience of traditional trades amidst modern transformations.

title: Kevin O’Leary-backed Utah AI data center plan downsized after local backlash
description: Kevin O’Leary-backed plans for a 40,000-acre AI data centre district in Utah have been cut to about 20,000 acres after strong local opposition. Residents have raised concerns over the project’s energy and water use, environmental impact and public review. Developers say the project could create thousands of jobs and support US computing and national defence.

title: Utah removes 17 million tons of radioactive waste from beside Colorado River
description: The Moab Uranium Mill Tailings Remedial Action Project has efficiently relocated 17 million tons of waste from the riverbank. Following rail transportation, teams are actively monitoring groundwater contamination levels. Upcoming efforts will also involve excavating contaminated soil near the original tailings site. The objective is to guarantee long-term safety and stability for local residents and the ecosystem. Ultimately, regrading and revegetating the area will be crucial in preventing future erosion.

title: Six years after his $10 billion climate pledge, Jeff Bezos turns to the Pacific Ocean
description: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund has announced more than $25 million in new ocean conservation grants across five Pacific nations. The funding will support marine protection and sustainable management across more than 625,000 square miles. The latest awards bring the fund’s Pacific commitment to $63.3 million of its planned $100 million.

title: Ohio farmer with $1m medical debt sold land after officials blocked solar lease
description: In Ohio, farmer Wayne Greier's financial struggles intensified when a planned solar project fell through due to local resistance and new rules, leaving his family's renewable energy plans in jeopardy. Compounded by $1 million in medical debt from recent health issues, Greier was forced to offload land and equipment, jeopardizing his farming business. He has emerged as an advocate for farmers' property rights to help protect others from similar hardships.
